title: Chapter 377: Commander
content:
Chapter 377: Commander

He exchanged all his extra resources for armor and other protective gear.

The armor was dark gold-level armor.

This gave Wang Shuo a headache.

If it was a one-on-one battle, Wang Shuo's Earth Dragon Beast Cavalry would still have the upper hand.

If the number of opponents was a certain scale and formed a defensive formation, then his charge might not be able to break the opponent's formation.

Fortunately, the number of opponents was not large, only more than 10 people, and their weapons were broadswords, not spears.

It was no longer possible to form a well-organized unit, which gave Wang Shuo a chance to win.

In the last battle, even if all the troops were used, as long as they could defeat the opponent, it would be enough.

The most brutal battle began.

Wang Shuo lined up the only more than ten cavalrymen, specifically attacking a general on the left side of the opponent's line.

In this way, it was equivalent to concentrating superior forces and focusing on one place.

Wang Shuo rushed in first, and Da Huang directly spit a mouthful of "corrosive flame" at the opponent.

Heavy infantrymen have strong defense against swords, but they are not so good at defending against this kind of corrosive gas.

The flame of corrosion penetrated through the gaps in the armor and immediately burned the heavy infantrymen, making them scream.

Seeing this effect, Wang Shuo stopped charging and stood directly on the opposite side, spraying "flame of corrosion" at the opponent.

The other earth dragon beasts continued to hit.

The damage caused by the spears in the hands of the knights was not as high as the damage caused by the collision of the earth dragon beasts.

Wang Shuo also directly let the earth dragon beasts serve as the main force of the attack.

As for the three generals, they launched a siege on the only general of the opponent.

Finally, after ten minutes of fierce fighting, the opponent was completely wiped out.

In this battle, Wang Shuo also realized what the mainstay of the battlefield was - heavy infantrymen.

At the same time, he paid attention to this general named Shanyue.

In the past, Wang Shuo always believed that there was nothing that could not be solved by a charge.

If there is, then do it again.

In this battle, if the opponent has hundreds or thousands of people, even if you have the same number of troops, you may not be able to defeat the opponent in a short time.

Of course, the disadvantages of this kind of heavy infantry are also very obvious.

That is, the movement speed is not fast. As long as the opponent is highly mobile, it is already invincible.

But the advantages are also obvious, that is, no matter what kind of troops the opponent is, it is difficult to defeat this kind of iron fool.

Wang Shuo immediately thought of his favorite general Gong Zheng. It seems necessary to convert Gong Zheng into this kind of heavy infantry.

At the same time, he is also a shield soldier. Wearing such dark gold heavy armor, the effect will definitely be better.

[Congratulations on winning the championship of this competition and becoming the supreme commander of this battle. ]

Wang Shuo was delighted.

[The reward for this competition is a resurrection coin. ]

Wang Shuo was very happy to see that his resurrection coin was not recovered.

Without the resurrection coin, Wang Shuo had no sense of security at all.

After the competition, all the main generals were teleported back to their bases.

At this time, Wang Shuo got a messenger prop.

It was equivalent to being able to directly issue mission orders to other commanders.

At the same time, he also got a sand table.

On the sand table was a topographical distribution map of the entire battlefield.

It was distinguished by three colors: red, yellow, and purple.

All of his bases and commanders were marked on the sand table.

Even the number of commanders in each commander's base was marked.

Wang Shuo was immediately filled with excitement, but also felt a great sense of responsibility.
